competency_fulfillment.rationale: All 7 samples say 'estimate the product' and each correct_answer is the product of both factors independently rounded to the nearest 10 (e.g. 12x11 -> 10x10=100; 13x19 -> 10x20=200, not the exact 247), matching the competency's stated method exactly.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: 13 of 14 individual factor-roundings across the 7 samples round DOWN (12->10, 23->20, 32->30, 24->20, 13->10, 23->20, 12->10, 13->10); only seed 55's 19->20 rounds up, and no sample exercises a ones-digit-5 tie case.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sentence forms are short and direct for grade 3, e.g. 'Estimate the product: 12 x 11' and 'Grace says: 13 x 19 ~ 180. Is Grace correct?', with no multi-clause word-problem language beyond a plain estimate-then-verify structure.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Four formatter types appear (mcq, cloze, true_false, error_detect) which is good structural variety, but all 7 samples are bare numeric expressions like '12 x 23' with zero word-problem or real-world context anywhere in the packet.

competency_alignment.rationale: Progression moves from direct recall (mcq seeds 42/43/45/46, cloze seed 44) to judging a stated estimate (true_false seed 50) to locating someone else's arithmetic error (error_detect seed 55), deepening the same rounding-and-multiplying skill rather than an unrelated axis.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency names '2- to 3-digit numbers by 1- to 2-digit numbers' but the largest factor shown across all 7 samples is 32 (seed 44); no sample rounds and multiplies a 3-digit number such as 120 or 350.
